The text describes a chain of events resulting from a power outage. The primary cause is the **unexpected power outage**, which directly led to the **servers going offline**. This server failure caused a **shutdown of all digital operations** for the company. The operational shutdown then had two main effects: it **affected global clients** and resulted in **contractual penalties** and a **dip in the company's stock price**.

Note: The text also contains an unrelated question about cleaning teeth, but this is not part of the cause-and-effect narrative regarding the power outage.
